description: Defines the HttpRequestHeaders class for managing HTTP request headers, including header storage, manipulation, and serialization.

classes.name: HttpRequestHeaders
classes.description: Manages HTTP request headers, allowing addition, removal, retrieval, and serialization of headers.

classes.name: HeaderKeyValuePair
classes.description: Represents a key-value pair for an HTTP header.

classes.name: Iterator
classes.description: Provides iteration over the headers in HttpRequestHeaders.

methods.name: IsEmpty
methods.description: Checks if there are no headers.

methods.name: HasHeader
methods.description: Checks if a header with the specified key exists.

methods.name: GetHeader
methods.description: Retrieves the value of the first header matching the key.

methods.name: SetHeader
methods.description: Sets or updates a header key-value pair.

methods.name: SetHeaderWithoutCheckForTesting
methods.description: Sets a header without validation checks, for testing purposes.

methods.name: SetHeaderIfMissing
methods.description: Sets a header only if it does not already exist.

methods.name: RemoveHeader
methods.description: Removes the first header matching the key.

methods.name: AddHeaderFromString
methods.description: Parses and adds a header from a string line.

methods.name: AddHeadersFromString
methods.description: Adds multiple headers from a string containing multiple header lines.

methods.name: MergeFrom
methods.description: Merges headers from another HttpRequestHeaders object.

methods.name: NetLogParams
methods.description: Generates a dictionary for logging, including request line and headers.

methods.name: SetAcceptEncodingIfMissing
methods.description: Sets the Accept-Encoding header if missing, based on URL and accepted stream types.
